status: frozen before any no-entropy training launch and before any lr1e-3 benchmark result
purpose: Test whether the generic AttnRes maximum-entropy reward prevents source and block specialization.

mechanism_evidence_before_freeze.online_lr1e3_check: At step 250, InternVL route entropy remains 1.219 despite a larger learning rate; no benchmark result exists yet.
mechanism_evidence_before_freeze.interpretation: The negative entropy term is acting as an almost exact uniform-routing prior in the architecture-light wrapper, suppressing the block/source differentiation that AttnRes is intended to learn.

change.description: Remove the uniform-routing reward and let the ordinary Full-path CE plus teacher KL determine source specialization.

matrix.schedule: starts after the matched InternVL Full AttnRes cell exits

candidate_must_exceed: its matched no-entropy Full AttnRes control by at least 0.15 percentage points
selection_and_confirmation.confirmation: A passing candidate must be rerun from the original pretrained model at seeds 1 and 2 before replacing the paper result.

material_passport.evaluation_data: local lmms-eval caches for the six formal VLM tasks
